note: The chapter opening passage P01 (which carries 'CHAPTER 13 BIODIVERSITY AND CONSERVATION' plus the introductory text) and the figure P02 sit before the 13.1 heading, so subtopic 1 carries from_heading 'unsure'. P22 is a bare heading passage reading only '13.2 BIODIVERSITY CONSERVATION' with no body text; rather than make a content-free subtopic for it, it is attached to the first subsection under it (subtopic 10). Figure passages P02, P07, P13 have empty text and are placed with the text immediately adjacent to them. Section 13.2.2 covers four separable conservation ideas (in situ/hotspots, India's protected areas, ex situ methods, international conventions) under one heading, so those four subtopics share a from_heading. The summary passage P32 is attached to subtopic 2; the exercise passage P33 (visible questions on the components of biodiversity, estimating total species, and hypotheses for tropical richness) is attached to subtopics 2, 3 and 4.
